chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 430: The Seven-Iris Trap—Why Greed Kills in the Mortal Stream
chapter_meta_description: Han Li’s expedition discovers a legendary Seven-Iris Flower in a pool of Thousand-Year Stone Milk. But when greed overrides caution, a gruesome poison trap turns treasure hunters into corpses.
og_title: The Beautiful Flower Was a Death Trap
og_description: When everything looks too perfect in a xianxia ruin, it usually is. Han Li watches as greed brings down an entire party.
twitter_title: Never Pick First: A Mortal Stream Lesson
twitter_description: A Seven-Iris Flower turns a treasure pool into a lethal trap. Han Li’s cold observation saves his life—again.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary spirit herb with multicolored petals, appearing in oral folklore but absent from formal alchemical texts; each petal color marks greater maturity.
A mineral-rich stalactite secretion prized in Daoist alchemy for purification and life-extending properties; its presence makes a poison trap doubly sinister.
A rare insect swarm under Han Li’s control; their destructive power is already infamous among the other cultivators, warping group dynamics into wary alignment against him.
